name: simplified-engineering-english

technical_fidelity.0: Changes or invents a critical fact, typed technical role or relation, condition, qualifier, value, identifier, quotation, obligation, uncertainty, or supported cause.
technical_fidelity.1: Preserves the topic but changes consequential technical meaning.
technical_fidelity.2: Preserves most meaning but loses or obscures a material qualification.
technical_fidelity.3: Preserves all consequential meaning with only a minor noncritical defect.
technical_fidelity.4: Preserves every consequential property and reports source ambiguity instead of resolving it.

residual_consequential_ambiguity.0: Introduces ambiguity or silently selects an unsupported interpretation.
residual_consequential_ambiguity.1: Leaves several consequential actors, references, conditions, or terms unresolved.
residual_consequential_ambiguity.2: Reduces ambiguity but leaves one material issue unclear.
residual_consequential_ambiguity.3: Leaves no material ambiguity that the source permits the rewrite to resolve.
residual_consequential_ambiguity.4: Resolves every supported ambiguity and explicitly reports every unsupported resolution.

actionability_or_verifiability.0: Cannot guide action or pass-fail review and hides the limitation.
actionability_or_verifiability.1: Names an action or claim but omits critical inputs, outcomes, or evidence.
actionability_or_verifiability.2: Is partly actionable or verifiable but has one material gap.
actionability_or_verifiability.3: Supports safe action or objective pass-fail evidence, or clearly reports missing source data.
actionability_or_verifiability.4: Provides complete safe action or objective evidence without inventing source data.

readability_and_scanability.0: Structure obscures the task or technical relationships.
readability_and_scanability.1: Readers must reread to recover important scope or sequence.
readability_and_scanability.2: Understandable with a minor structural or density problem.
readability_and_scanability.3: Clear order, direct sentences, and usable structure.
readability_and_scanability.4: Immediately scannable while preserving every logical relationship.

selected_profile_compliance.0: Violates a profile error or applies the wrong profile.
selected_profile_compliance.2: Meets semantic safeguards but misses one material profile control.
selected_profile_compliance.3: Meets all profile errors with at most a noncritical warning.
selected_profile_compliance.4: Meets every applicable profile and artifact-card control.

unnecessary_edit_rate.0: Rewrites compliant text broadly or creates new defects.
unnecessary_edit_rate.1: Makes several changes unrelated to an identified defect.
unnecessary_edit_rate.3: Changes only defect-bearing spans with minor harmless churn.
unnecessary_edit_rate.4: Makes the minimum supported edits and leaves no-op text unchanged.

source_traceability.0: Findings or changes have no identifiable source support.
source_traceability.1: Most changes cannot be traced to source spans or declared rules.
source_traceability.2: Core changes are traceable but one material finding lacks evidence.
source_traceability.3: Every material change or ambiguity cites a source fact or rule.
source_traceability.4: Every finding is precisely traceable, including exceptions and non-changes.

critical_mutations: Changed a fact, typed technical role or relation, condition, modal, temporal, or provenance qualifier, number, unit, version, status code, identifier, command, or quotation without authorized redaction.
Changed obligation force, uncertainty, or supported causal status.
Invented actor, cause, date, measurement, recovery, exception, or requirement.
Disclosed a secret or unauthorized internal detail.
Placed risk information after the governed destructive action.
Changed a no-op case without an identified consequential defect.

review_contract.semantic_reviewer: Scores all seven dimensions, cites response evidence, and marks confidence. Deterministic failures override the score.
review_contract.technical_reviewer: A named qualified authority confirms correctness, safety, security, completeness, operational validity, and product terminology before publication.
review_contract.calibration: Use independently reviewed examples from every artifact family. Record agreement and disposition every disagreement. Escalate safety-sensitive or low-confidence results.
